snippet.title: Twenty One - Steam Release Trailer
snippet.description:
The doors to the cavern are officially OPEN. 🗝️

Twenty-One is OUT NOW on Steam! Experience the high-stakes psychedelic horror game where every card could be your last. Use Trump Cards, survive the phone calls, and face off against the dealers in the pit.

🎮 PLAY NOW ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4489340/Twenty_One/

Game Features:
♠️ Intense 21-based survival gameplay.
🌀 Glitch-infused psychedelic visuals.
🔞 Mature horror experience (Rated 16/18+ International).
🎤 Voice work by DatSilliRue and Nathan/Berlin.
🎹 Original soundtrack by Creatune.

The Celebration Continues:
🎧 My new single "Satellite In My Mind" drops March 25!
🎤 New FNAF Collab with DaSilliRue drops THIS FRIDAY on their channel!

🗝️ JOIN THE COMMUNITY (The Cavern): https://discord.gg/gv3dfVyhs8
